upstream_requirement.text: Determine whether retrieval augmentation changes factual answer quality and record both the reported effect and any limits on generalization.
obligations: retrieve source-grounded evidence about factual answer quality

epistemic_route.semantic_intent: Locate empirical evaluations of retrieval augmentation and factual answer quality.
epistemic_route.independence_rationale: The route is defined by an empirical evidence obligation rather than a named paper, author, identifier, or dominant explanatory frame.
epistemic_route.framing_consequence: Separates observed factuality effects from claims about universal generalization.
epistemic_route.evidence_need: reported empirical result concerning factual answer quality
epistemic_route.search_intent: Discover candidate studies without supplying an expected evidence identity.
epistemic_route.uncertainty: Reported gains may depend on corpus, task, and evaluation design.

preserved_obligations: retrieve source-grounded evidence about factual answer quality
requirement_route_fidelity_review.rationale: The route preserves the effect and limitation obligations and does not replace them with a known-paper lookup.

proposition_requests.text: The selected study reports an empirical factual-quality benefit associated with retrieval augmentation.
The selected study establishes that the reported benefit transfers without limitation across all domains and corpora.
